images.filename: Lligwy Burial Chamber. - geograph.org.uk - 219.jpg
images.caption: Lligwy Burial Chamber. Dating to the Neolithic and still used during the Bronze age, this Burial chamber was once covered in a mound of earth. The capstone is estimated to weigh in excess of 28 tonnes.
images.alt: Lligwy Burial Chamber. Dating to the Neolithic and still used during the Bronze age, this Burial chamber was once covered in a mound of earth. The capstone is estimated to weigh in excess of 28 tonnes.

images.filename: The Lligwy Burial Chamber from the entrance to Plas Lligwy Farm - geograph.org.uk - 752636.jpg
images.caption: The Lligwy Burial Chamber from the entrance to Plas Lligwy Farm Few farmers are as blessed (or cursed?) as to have three first ranking ancient monuments on his land. These monuments are cared for by Cadw - the historic environment service of the Welsh Assembly Government, and access to all three, along designated paths, is unrestricted.
